title: The Case of the Unsinkable Ship
slogan: AI NEWS · HUMAN-CENTRED · HUMANS IN CONTROL
music: Elegiac cinematic score for a night at sea in 1912: slow solo cello and piano, soft strings, distant ship bell, sorrowful but dignified, minor key, no vocals.
ambience: Calm open ocean at night, gentle water lapping against a large ship's hull, faint wind, distant engine hum, no music.

sources.name: US Senate & British Wreck Commissioner inquiries (1912)

shots.say: Case eight, part one. April fourteenth, nineteen twelve. The largest ship afloat crosses a calm, black Atlantic.

ov.text: THE SIR JACK FILES · CASE 08 · PART 1

sfx.prompt: Deep steamship horn far away on a calm sea at night

shots.say: All day, the wireless room took ice warnings from other ships. Not all of them reached the bridge.

ov.text:
ICE WARNINGS:
SEVERAL. HEEDED: TOO FEW.

sfx.prompt: Old wireless telegraph morse code beeping with static crackle

shots.say: Eleven forty at night. A lookout in the crow's nest sees a shape ahead, and rings the bell. Iceberg, right ahead.

ov.by: lookout Frederick Fleet, as reported to the inquiries

sfx.prompt: Ship's brass bell struck three times sharply at night

shots.say: Too late to turn. The ice scraped along the starboard side and opened the forward compartments. She could float with four flooded. At least five were open.

ov.text: BUILT FOR 4 FLOODED · AT LEAST 5 OPEN

sfx.prompt: Long deep metallic scraping and grinding of a ship hull against ice, low rumble
Water rushing into a large metal compartment, deep and echoing

shots.say: There were twenty lifeboats, with room for about eleven hundred and seventy people. More than twenty-two hundred were aboard.

sfx.prompt: Wooden oars rowing slowly on calm water at night, quiet voices far away

shots.say: At two twenty in the morning, Titanic was gone. More than fifteen hundred people died. After that night the rules changed: lifeboats for all, radios on watch all night, an ice patrol. Part two: why we never stopped watching.

sfx.prompt: Utterly calm sea at night, faint lapping water, deep silence
